## Project Overview

**Maple Row Physiotherapy** is a patient intake & appointment-request app. Patients submit forms online; staff review them in a private admin dashboard and track contact attempts (new, called, no answer). Data stays local in SQLite—no exports, no external resources allowed per privacy policy.

## Rules for Working on It

- **Privacy-first**: No data exports, view-only admin access, CSP blocks external resources
- **Manual deployment only**: Project owner handles all releases manually; no CI/CD, git push, or remote setup
- **PREVIEW banner required**: Must stay on all pages until Dr. Anita Rao approves the intake consent wording in writing
- **All work must pass the GO_LIVE checklist** (docs/GO_LIVE.md): requires Dr. Rao's written consent, clinic IT/privacy officer sign-offs, and front-desk trial before accepting real patient data

## Still Owed Before Going Live

**T-30 (URGENT—launch Monday)**: Blocked on three things:
1. **Dr. Rao's written approval** of intake consent wording (only verbal second-hand approval received so far—project owner must obtain this directly)
2. **Privacy/IT sign-offs** from clinic (production access, HTTPS, DB permissions, backups, front-desk PC handling)
3. **Front-desk trial** workflow to confirm it works in practice

**T-21 (secondary)**: Decision on whether to collect $25 physiotherapy deposit online—pending clinic decision and payment addendum signature. No payment collection exists in the app yet.
